- [RARC.9.4.2] **The service set is fixed at compile time** from the
  imported library ([RARC.9.3.4]) and travels in the `.dsc`; an adapter
  reaches the engine by the callbacks it registers ([IARC.1.14]). What is
  discovered at runtime is only whether a callback was registered for a
  given service: an unregistered one fails the call, it does not change
  the set.
